transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because I've been having some trouble with my eating. 

After work, or after my classes, I usually just sit down with my laptop and... I end up eating a lot. Like, a whole takeout meal, and then chips, and sweets... basically whatever snacks I have stashed in my desk drawer. 

It's just... it's way more than I ever actually plan to eat. And definitely more than I would ever eat if anyone else was around.
Do you usually feel guilty after eating all those snacks?
Um... yeah. I guess I do. It's not really something I like to think about, but... yeah. I feel bad afterward.
Do you try to get rid of the calories from the snacks after you eat them?
Um... no. I don't really do anything like that. I just... I don't do anything.
Do you feel like you can't stop eating once you start with those snacks?

Um... yeah. I guess so. 

It's... it's kind of like I'm just watching myself keep reaching for the next thing. Like, in my head I'm thinking, *Jaime, stop, you have a budget report to finish*... but I just keep going. Even when I'm not even enjoying it anymore.
Do you feel like you're in control while you're eating those snacks?
Um... no. Like I was just saying, it just feels like I'm watching myself do it. Even when I'm telling myself to stop... I can't. So, no. Not really.
How often do these episodes of eating a lot of snacks happen?

Um... I guess, when I really looked at it... like, checking my journal and... my food delivery charges... it's been happening most weeks. Ever since the company restructuring started. Usually... usually more than once a week. It's not just a once-in-a-while thing anymore.
Do you feel like you're eating really fast during these episodes?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't noticed. I don't think it's... unusually fast or anything. I just haven't really paid attention to that part.
Do you usually eat those snacks when you're feeling stressed or upset?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't... I don't really pay attention to how I'm feeling right then. It just sort of happens.
Have you noticed any big changes in your weight over the past few months?
Um... no, not really. I don't really weigh myself that often. So... I haven't noticed anything major.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like within a couple of hours?

Um... yeah, I guess so. That's sort of what made me come in, actually. Like... after work or class, I'll just sit down with my laptop and... I don't know, I just end up eating a whole takeout meal. And then chips, and sweets... basically whatever snacks are in my desk drawer. It's... it ends up being way more than I ever planned to eat. I definitely wouldn't eat like that around anyone else, though.
Do you think about the calories or trying to diet while you're eating those snacks?
Um... I don't really think about it. I'm not... I don't really diet. I just kind of eat it.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating?
Um... no. No, I don't do that.
Do you feel like your eating habits are causing you a lot of distress?
Um... I mean, I guess so. It... it bothers me, I suppose. Just... yeah.
Have these episodes of eating a lot of snacks been happening for more than three months?
Um... yeah, I guess. Maybe like... four months or so. It kind of started when they restructured the office and I had to start staying late for reporting deadlines. So... yeah.
Do you think you eat those snacks as a way to deal with feelings or stress?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't thought about it like that. I just... I just eat them, I guess.
Do you think eating those snacks helps you feel better when you're stressed or upset?
Um... not really. I mean, I don't think it actually makes me feel better. I just... I don't really pay attention to how I'm feeling right then. I just do it.
Do you think you eat those snacks because you're feeling overwhelmed or upset?
I don't know... I mean, maybe? I just... I don't really know why I do it. I just eat.
Do you think eating those snacks is a way for you to cope with your emotions?
Um... I really don't know. Like I said, I just... I don't really connect the two. I'm sorry, I just don't know what else to tell you about it.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight, such as gaining or losing a lot of weight, over the past few months?
Um... no, not really. I don't weigh myself much, so... I haven't noticed anything like that.
Do you ever do things like fasting, or excessively exercise, after eating a lot of snacks?
No... not really. I don't really exercise much anyway, so... no, I don't do anything like that.
